headline: Parcel Tax. Rada Supports Draft Law
summary: Ukraine's parliament supported a draft law on taxing parcels. Currently, parcels from foreign online stores valued up to €150 are not subject to VAT.
why: Low-value cross-border e-commerce parcels have been a growing channel for foreign online retailers, so changes to VAT exemptions affect their pricing and volumes in the market. Import tax rules also shape domestic retail competition.
